meta.coordinates: nodes = [x, y, walk_id]; x,y in metres, the merged-map estimated camera centre C=-R^T t, mapped into the GT frame by a per-step, per-connected-component rigid transform fitted to GT; the plane is GT axes x,y (GT position variance per axis [65461.2, 16921.7, 12.4]). links = [node_a, node_b] indices into nodes of the same step, cross-walk covis edges only
meta.walk_assignment: node belongs to the submap whose merge step appended it; cross-checked with raw timestamps
meta.ate_definition: ate_rmse_m = RMSE of position after aligning each connected component of the step (odom+covis graph) to GT with its own rigid transform (Umeyama, no scale), pooled over nodes; ate_rmse_single_align_m = one rigid alignment for all nodes, as literally requested; they differ when the map is split into components that live in different frames
meta.note: only the real submaps (0-54) are included
